A leading global Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) solutions provider company appointed Dr. Evelyn R Carter as the President.
In her new role, she will drive innovation around effective approaches to DEI work, and use those insights to evolve Paradigm's comprehensive suite of technology, tools, and consulting services.
Previously, Evelyn served as the Managing Director (MD) of Paradigm's Training & People Development practice. .

As the MD she advised leaders across industries on how to build more diverse, equitable, and inclusive organisations and managed a large team of consultants focused on educating and upskilling workforces around DEI.
